            result[i] = Integer.parseInt(parts[i]);
        }
        return result;
    }

    boolean isSubArrayBalanced(int[] arr, int index){
        int evenCount = 0;
        int oddCount = 0;
        for(int i=0; i<=index; i++){
            if(arr[i] % 2 == 0) evenCount++;
            else oddCount++;
        }
        return evenCount == oddCount;

            if(cost < minCost && isSubArrayBalanced(arr, i) && !usedCuts.containsKey(i)){
                minCost = cost;
                minIndex = i;
            }
        }
        return minIndex;

                cutsCount++;

            }
